subject: Convert a list of N dataframes to N dataframes

messages.author: d640f02d29e7de63
messages.subject: Convert a list of N dataframes to N dataframes
parts:
Hello,

I have used the following command:

datalist<-list(data1,data2,data3,data4,data5,data6)

to make a list of my dataframes, which I then manipulated with these commands:

datalist<-llply(datalist,"LogDepth")
datalist<-llply(datalist,"LogArea")
datalist<-llply(datalist,"p")
datalist<-llply(datalist,"Exp")
datalist<-llply(datalist,"s")

This worked very nicely (thanks for plyr, Hadley) but now I would like to "unlist" my list into the individual dataframes, preferably with their original names (data1, etc).

I've tried to do this with:

> ldply(datalist,unlist)

but that's not working. Any help with this would be much appreciated.

Thanks, Mark

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: Convert a list of N dataframes to N dataframes
parts:
Hi,

I'm not sure why you would not want to keep those data.frames in a
list, but if you insist on having them as separate objects in the
global environment you could use ?assign,

data1 <- data.frame(a=1:10, b=letters[1:10])
data2 <- data.frame(a=rnorm(10), b=LETTERS[1:10])

datalist<-list(data1,data2)
datalist <- llply(datalist, transform, c=a^2)

names(datalist) <- paste("data", 1:2, sep="")

l_ply(seq_along(datalist), function(l)
assign(names(datalist[l]), datalist[[l]], pos=1) )


HTH,

baptiste

messages.subject: Re: Convert a list of N dataframes to N dataframes
parts:
On Mon, Dec 7, 2009 at 8:51 PM, Mark Na <mtb...@gmail.com> wrote:
I want to export each list element as
> a .csv file, and I don't know how to do that when they're bound together
> into a list...
>

something like this should do,

l_ply(seq_along(datalist), function(l)
write.csv(file=paste(names(datalist[l]), ".csv", sep=""), datalist[[l]]) )

HTH,

baptiste
